name: Multi-Functional Folding Sofa Bed / Sleeper Couch
description: The ultimate space-saving solution for small apartments, dorms, or hosting overnight guests! This versatile black folding sofa bed easily transitions from a stylish low-profile accent chair/loveseat into a comfortable lounge sleeper bed in just seconds. Built with high-density supportive foam and wrapped in a durable black fabric upholstery. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a cat. The sofa bed has been thoroughly vacuumed, deep cleaned, and lint-rolled. It is structurally solid with no major damage, though it shows typical faint surface signs of pet ownership. Extremely practical, lightweight enough to rearrange easily, and a total studio apartment essential!
contact_note: Cat-friendly home. The folding bed will be thoroughly lint-rolled and deep-cleaned one final time right before your arrival. It folds up into a compact block making it surprisingly easy to transport in most standard cars or SUVs!
meta_description: Pre-owned multi-functional folding sleeper sofa bed in black fabric. Convertible design for guests and small spaces, pet-friendly home, fully cleaned.
name_zh: 多功能可折叠懒人沙发床 / 地板床垫 (黑色)
description_zh: 小户型、单身公寓以及临时留宿客人的绝对空间扩容神器！这款黑色多功能折叠沙发床，展开后是一张舒适的单人/双人加宽地板床垫，折叠起来则秒变舒适的低重心靠背沙发椅。采用高密度多层回弹海绵，支撑性极强，久睡不塌陷。特别说明：家里养猫，虽然在发布和自提前都会进行极其彻底的吸尘与除毛清理，无严重猫抓破洞，但面料上不可避免会有轻微宠物痕迹。折叠后呈方块状，普通轿车后排或后备箱即可轻松运走。
